summary: Iteration 5 — security hardening audit. NEW test_security.py (18 tests, all PASS) covers: (1) every /api response carries X-Frame-Options=SAMEORIGIN, X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff, Referrer-Policy=strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy; (2) admin endpoints accept X-Admin-Token header (200) and reject wrong/missing header (403) with constant-time compare; (3) legacy path-token admin endpoints still return 200 (backward compat) and reject wrong path tokens with 403; (4) full new POST /api/partner-requests → POST /api/admin/partner-requests/{TOKEN}/{rid}/approve flow returns ok+upload_token; (5) /api/voice/chat with session_id='###' or '<script>...' or 100+ chars returns 400/422; (6) error responses do NOT leak 'traceback', 'LLM error:', 'openai', 'exception' substrings; (7) rate limits fire — POST /api/partner-requests bursts to 14 hit 429, POST /api/voice/chat bursts to 45 hit 429; (8) regression smoke /api/cities, /api/categories, /api/pharmacies, /api/search, /api/upload/me/{token} all 200. Frontend Playwright: /partner-admin?token=<correct> loads 25 'Новые' rows via X-Admin-Token header (no token in URL); /partner-admin?token=WRONG shows 'Неверный токен администратора'; /partner-admin (no param) shows 'Требуется токен'; home loads cleanly with title 'АптекаА — поиск лекарств и сравнение цен в аптеках Москвы' and zero error elements/console errors. All security objectives met.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py defines its own _rate_limit() and _RL_BUCKETS while api/partners.py and api/uploads.py each have a near-identical _rate_limit_or_429/_rate_limit_or_403. Same in-memory algorithm copy-pasted three times across modules — extract a single utility (e.g. security.rate_limit) to avoid drift. Acceptable for MVP but a refactor target.

Rate limiter is per-process in-memory: under k8s ingress IP fan-out (preview env routes via 10.79.131.92 + 10.79.131.93) effective per-client limit is N×limit. For production single-VPS deploy this is fine, but under any horizontal scaling switch to Redis-backed limiter (e.g. fastapi-limiter) before adding workers.

/api/voice/chat runs Pydantic body validation BEFORE _rate_limit(), so a flood of bodies missing required fields would 422 without consuming the bucket — a determined attacker could DoS the LLM by sending VALID minimal bodies. Validate that body cost is modest enough this is acceptable, or move rate-limit to a middleware so it always runs first.

SecurityHeadersMiddleware applies CSP to ALL responses including audio/ogg from /api/voice/tts and the upload XLSX/CSV — CSP on a binary body is harmless but X-Content-Type-Options=nosniff combined with the explicit Content-Type=audio/ogg is correct; verified streaming TTS still functions in earlier iterations.

PartnerAdmin.jsx uses axios.post(url, null, {headers}) — works, but consider migrating to a small api client with the X-Admin-Token attached via interceptor so future admin pages don't repeat header config. Low priority.
ADMIN_TOKEN is in /app/backend/.env (gitignored per .gitignore in this iteration — good). On production server make sure file permissions are 600 root-only — document this in the deploy runbook.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_security.py -v` (18 tests) for the security hardening regression. NOTE: the rate-limit tests CONSUME the per-IP partner-requests bucket (5/hour). If you re-run other tests that POST /api/partner-requests within the same hour, expect 429s — this is correct behavior, not a bug. Wait ~1 hour or restart backend to clear in-memory buckets between runs. Voice/chat bucket is 20/min — clears within a minute. The k8s preview ingress fans requests across at least 2 pod IPs so bursts must be larger than (limit × pod_count) to reliably hit 429.
rca of the issue: N/A — no security regressions detected. The 5 'failures' in the broader regression suite (test_catalog_api, test_partners_and_prefix, test_enrichment_and_admin) all stem from rate-limit bucket exhaustion caused by THIS iteration's burst tests (14× partner-requests + 45× voice/chat). They pass when run in isolation or after bucket reset. This actually CONFIRMS the rate limiter is working end-to-end.
